review_notes: I read the whole file. I searched Mathlib's GroupLike files under RingTheory/Bialgebra and RingTheory/Coalgebra for `GroupLike.map`, `groupLikeMap` and any map on group-like elements. I found none. Mathlib has `IsGroupLikeElem.map`, the `GroupLike` carrier and its monoid structure, and `valMonoidHom`, but no `GroupLike R A →* GroupLike R B` induced by a `BialgHom`. `BialgHom.groupLikeMap` therefore does not compete with an existing Mathlib concept. It is a thin monoid-hom wrapper over the repo's own `GroupLike.map`, and other files in the repo use it (HopfAlgebra/GroupLike, tests). I found no duplicated concept to report. One residual uncertainty: `GroupLike.map` lives in the sibling file Coalgebra/GroupLikeHom, which I did not review under this rubric.
